input.description: Bedding. Linen. Actually-breathable stuff made in Portugal. Our customers are mostly people who got tired of the Brooklinen/Parachute aesthetic and want something a little more grown-up.

brief.statusReason: The advertiser clearly describes selling Portuguese linen bedding to adults seeking an elevated aesthetic compared to popular DTC bedding brands.
brief.productSummary: Breathable linen bedding made in Portugal sold to adults seeking mature, elevated home essentials at a premium price point.
assumptions: Assumed an estimated average order value of around $250 typical for European linen bedding sets.
Assumed target age begins around late 20s based on the 'more grown-up' positioning relative to entry DTC brands.

plan.reviewNote: The inventory is anchored by strong home and life-stage cross-shopping candidates, while apparel and grocery options offer varying degrees of alignment depending on craftsmanship appeal.

creatives.whyThisPersona: This audience values lasting craftsmanship and European heritage over fleeting trends, making them an ideal match for your Portuguese linen. Their low price sensitivity aligns naturally with your premium price point.
creatives.headline: Made in Portugal Linen Bedding
creatives.body: Grown-up bedding woven for true breathability. Experience understated Portuguese craftsmanship made to endure.

creatives.whyThisPersona: Lifelong milestones and new-home celebrations demand impressive, tangible luxury that stands apart from ubiquitous DTC brands. Linen bedding from Portugal provides an elevated, memorable gift with immediate premium appeal.
creatives.headline: An Elevated Home Gift
creatives.body: Give breathable linen bedding crafted in Portugal. A mature, elevated essential designed to impress any recipient.

creatives.whyThisPersona: This buyer seeks transparent, origin-specific manufacturing over mass-market fast home goods. Your authentic Portuguese production and pure linen construction appeal directly to their mindful purchase criteria.
creatives.headline: Authentic Portuguese Linen
creatives.body: Know exactly where your sheets come from. Breathable linen bedding sourced and made transparently in Portugal.

bidding.rationale: Start on CPM bids for 14 days to buy reach and collect conversion data (there is no history yet), then switch to a target CPA once each publisher has ~30 conversions.

creativeRotation.strategy: Even rotation for 14 days, then shift weight to the best CTR per publisher.

assumptions: No budget given: assumed $10,000 for a 30-day test.
CPMs are estimated from each audience's income tier (+15% for audiences under 5M monthly impressions); real prices come from the auction.
One-time purchase: target CPA = 30% of order value as a margin-safe default.
No publisher gets more than 25% of its monthly impressions, so no single audience is saturated.
Assumed an estimated average order value of around $250 typical for European linen bedding sets.
Assumed target age begins around late 20s based on the 'more grown-up' positioning relative to entry DTC brands.

output.understanding: The advertiser offers elevated, breathable Portuguese-crafted linen bedding tailored to design-conscious adults seeking sophisticated craftsmanship over mainstream DTC trends.

publishers.rationale: Direct endemic alignment as a premium bedding and home textiles publisher with an affluent, design-conscious audience and a high average order value.
High-AOV home goods audience with high crossover intent for non-toxic, sustainable materials and home upgrade milestones.
Captures mature, affluent shoppers who prioritize lasting craftsmanship and understated quality over fleeting aesthetic trends.

excluded.reason: Convenience and instant grocery platform unsuited for considered, high-AOV home textile purchases.
Activewear audience focused primarily on fitness apparel rather than elevated home goods.
Fitness and spa appointment platform with minimal intent for physical home decor products.
Audience skews overly traditional and conservative compared to modern design-forward bedding.
Exclusively focused on size-inclusive apparel and intimates, lacking home and bedding relevance.
Niche pet health and nutrition platform with no category crossover.
Pantry and organic food focus, offering weaker direct conversion potential than dedicated home channels.
Mass-market pet supply destination lacking contextual relevance for luxury home goods.
Lower-AOV basic apparel audience that skews toward budget essentials rather than premium linens.
DTC supplement platform centered on ingestible wellness rather than home environments.
Gen Z and youth beauty audience looking for inexpensive, social-first cosmetic purchases.
Meal kit subscription service not aligned with high-end interior furnishing purchases.
Footwear-specific focus with limited ad inventory for broader home categories.
Focuses on tech-casual and active footwear rather than interior design.
Playful millennial pet subscription platform misaligned with refined linen aesthetics.
Personalized haircare focus with audience targeting tailored purely to beauty routines.
Impulse beverage platform with lower AOV and off-category traffic.
